checks.name: Original MG5 event ensemble and native libraries
checks.observed: Exact parent gzip and decompressed bytes; Pythia and HepMC wheel hashes match
checks.method: Authenticate file and wheel package hashes; bind preset XML/particle data to native execution.

checks.name: Leptonic QED shower and off control
checks.observed: 128 accepted each; off=0 photons, on=79 events with photons and 67 with E>1 MeV
checks.method: Equal raw initial sample, differing QED-lepton switch only; beam/final statuses and PDGs checked.

checks.name: Final-vs-beam four-momentum
checks.method: Independently sum projected momenta component-wise; validate energies, PDGs and final-state status.

checks.name: Parent LHE nominal cross section and weight
checks.method: Compare nominal Pythia strategem -4 weights in pb and sigmaGen in mb times 1e9 to the frozen LHE init normalization.

checks.name: HepMC3 projected identity and vectors
checks.method: Reopen HepMC3 ASCII, require GeV/mm, event sequence, weight and cross section, identical status/PDGs and projected vectors.

checks.name: Wrong input or output units fail closed
checks.method: Run on wrong parent bytes and reopen valid file with first unit changed from GEV to MEV.

checks.name: All three output artefacts match on separate replay
checks.method: Independent process using authenticated wheels and same fixed seeds produces exact HepMC and JSON bytes.
